content: {"summary":"Customers report frequent flight delays causing missed connections and job‑related stress, with many citing specific incidents such as a 25‑minute delay that led to a missed Boston conference [tk_2631921] and a delayed 1366 flight that jeopardized a work deadline [tk_2885333]. Mechanical and operational issues—battery failures, de‑icing delays, and wire problems—exacerbate frustration, as seen in a 2‑hour de‑icing wait that caused missed connections and hotel mismanagement [tk_2601036]. Overall, passengers demand better communication and contingency plans to avoid stranded situations [tk_2708612]."}
